items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Just like Kobe and Meyers, the lawyers.

ctx.x: You know. Jesus. Tattoos here and there. And pin put through it all. Oh, man. You know, that's the same as Sodom and Gomorra. That's the same way like things happen, because you know because people are catering to their senses. You know. And the senses really don't mean that much if you don't rise them above animal level. You know? So, and you put all that together. You know what it's like? It's like a barrel full of rotten apples. And you take a nice apple and you put it in there. I'm not saying I'm a nice…

I bought some medicine. No, my honey did the other day. You know. A hundred tablets. A hundred pills. Now I'm not even going to say it. Tell her how much it cost honey. FEMALE: It was approximately a hundred and thirty dollars.
